svg.title: Mind Map Studio: import, export and share
svg.desc: A looping animation in four scenes. 1: a project ZIP is dragged onto the window and dropped, and the project opens with its map and picture. 2: the map is focused on the branch Launch Plan with the tag filter #p1 set to hide other nodes; Export, PNG image saves a picture of just the two visible nodes under Launch Plan. 3: an exported HTML page opened from a file: the ✎ marker opens a node’s notes, Esc closes them, the map zooms, and a thumbnail opens full size. 4: GitHub milestones saves the project to a private repository with the message Pricing tiers agreed and the tag v1-plan, and History restores a milestone as a snapshot.

g.text: Drop a project, a ZIP with pictures, or a Markdown outline onto the app.
PNG image: just what the map shows
PNG, SVG and print frame the focused branch, without nodes a tag filter hides.
Notes, zoom and pictures in one file that loads nothing from the network.
Saves “Launch plan” to your-name/mindmap-backups as a commit you can come back to.
Added snapshot “GitHub 2026-10-24 (3f9c2a1)”. Open Project ▾ → Snapshots to restore it.
Save a project to your private repository as a commit, optionally tagged.
